thread:
olivia: Noticed a spike in SAML 401s for customers in eu-central starting ~03:10 UTC. About 80 failures across 10 tenants. OIDC unaffected.

kevin: Any CI/CD or infra changes around that time?

olivia: We performed a KMS alias swap for signing keys at 03:05 (key rewrap). No deploys.

maria: KMS alias swaps can be a problem if verifier nodes cache KMS key IDs or JWK metadata. Did we push a JWKS refresh?

olivia: No manual refresh. Verifier errors show: 
```
2026-03-21T03:12:02Z verifier=eu idp=globex err="saml: signature validation failed: unknown key id arn:aws:kms:eu-central-1:123:key/abcd"
```

luis: Also seeing a related SCIM loop — deprovision requests for the same user reappearing. Might be retries due to 5xx from provisioner. Could be correlated.

devops-bot: ALERT: 78 saml_auth_failures in 10m for region=eu-central. Rate > threshold.

kevin: If the KMS alias rebind happened, some services might have watched the alias name but kept the resolved key ARN in local cache. That would break verification until cache cleared.

olivia: I can trigger a rolling restart of verifier pods, but prefer a less disruptive step first: force JWKS/KMS metadata refresh. Command I use: 
```
kubectl -n infra exec -it verifier-abc -- curl -X POST http://localhost:9000/admin/refresh-keys
```

maria: Also bump the JWKS refresh interval temporarily and add an immediate scrape for metrics exporters to pick up the new key ids.

ops: While you do that, I'm checking the provisioning downstream: the deprovisioner returned 502s around 03:06-03:09 causing our retry backoff to republish events. That caused duplicate webhook attempts.

luis: That matches the user loop I traced: id=usr_984, event=deprovision, retry count increased then duplicated after backoff expiration.

olivia: Kicking refresh now...

olivia: Response: 200 OK, keys_reloaded=4. Failures drop to single digits within 45s.

security-bot: NOTE: forced key refresh at 03:14 UTC by olivia.

kevin: Good. For a durable fix: update KMS rotation playbook to 1) publish new alias, 2) trigger orchestrated key metadata refresh across verifier fleet, 3) only complete rotation when health checks pass.

maria: Also add audit-hook: when KMS alias changes, emit an event to provisioning-topic so consumers can avoid checkpointing during that window.

ops: For the SCIM duplicates: we replayed the failed offsets and deduplicated deprovision webhook calls. We also raised the retry expiry window to 15m to avoid immediate duplicate delivery after transient 5xxs.

luis: After replay, user state reconciled for 12 affected accounts.

kevin: Follow-ups: INFRA-2325 for rotation orchestration, SEC-880 for audit/checkpoint policy, and add metric jwks_alias_mismatch_rate with alerting.

maria: Also put a canary in the rotation pipeline: pick 3 verifier pods in a canary AZ, rotate key, verify sign/verify roundtrip before rotating rest.

olivia: I'll draft a short incident note and add timeline + commands used. Ops, can you verify audit rows for 03:00-03:20 once more?

ops: Verified. Audit counts match after replay. No further 5xxs in the provisioner.

olivia: Great. Scheduling work items now. Thanks team. :+1:
